name: live-studio-mobile
description: Live Studio V16.1 - Capacitor iOS and Android shell

scripts.web:sync: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npm run plugin:build && esbuild scripts/native-bridge.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/native-bridge.js
scripts.ios:sync: npm run web:sync && cap sync ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:sync && cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
